title: Naturality from ordinary tensor resolution transport
statement: K-flat resolution transport data imply naturality of the extended ordinary tensor model.

source.place: Native tensor transport, geometric tensor part of step 1; K-flat replacement extension.

proof.text: For a map of arbitrary second complexes choose the common K-flat roof supplied by the resolution-lift clause.
Expand both sides by the transport equation, apply hkflat to the roof map, and use homotopy invariance of the derived localization to identify the augmentation composites.
Cancel the localized quasi-isomorphism factors to obtain naturality in both variables.
